packet_admission.scope: Single basic NTP association; common fixed raw clock, offered wire packets and externally supplied requests; output discipline frozen; UDP sockets/autonomous scheduling and receive-timeout policy excluded. Loss means an omitted reply between supplied requests.

deliberate_stricter_profile_differences.wrong_version: Bounded client supports NTPv3/v4; Chrony also admits v2.
deliberate_stricter_profile_differences.root_distance: Pico applies its existing 3-second distance gate before fitting.
deliberate_stricter_profile_differences.zero_reference: Zero reference is outside the Pico era/coherence profile.

fixed_coordinate_histories.scope: Instantaneous common raw midpoint, peer delay and dispersion; no control loop or packet admission.

known_truth_loops.scope: Complete source-statistics/selection/clock-feedback loops; common physical timestamp events; external Chrony packet admission and automatic polling excluded

rate_benefit.scope: Zero initial learned frequency; same physical inputs; phase-only control suppresses learning in offline adapters only. Positive RMS gain means learned frequency helps.

limits: Cold zero-frequency initialization; incomplete pre-capture boot history.
Admitted originals only; rejected packets and autonomous polling excluded.
Stable endpoint/epoch per slot required; no association reconstruction.
Pulse UTC path delay and reference allowance are not calibrated.
Replay output is not evidence of firmware application on a board.
No RF correction or independent absolute UTC qualification.
captured_subset.cold_acquisition: Chrony RTC versus Pico first epoch assignment; zero learned frequency.
captured_subset.matched_rtc_acquisition: Common synthetic initial RTC at the first-sample translated origin; zero learned frequency. Conditional prior, not recovered boot state.
